scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:exe
scripts.build:exe: bun run build:resources && bun build apps/api/src/portable-main.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/AnimaStudio.exe
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "bun run --cwd apps/api start" "bun run --cwd apps/web start"
